items.description: IbizaA-Z.com and Ibiza Now Magazine. Everything from one Google Map.
Share your cycling, walking, hiking, and paddling routes with the world. See maps, photos, and stats about each route, or create your own.
Gifts for various occasions such as holidays, weddings, birthdays, wedding anniversaries, graduations, kids and other special occasions.

School Performance Maps provides a bird's eye view of public school performance in California. Data from California Department of Education, Academic Performance Index. The 1-10 is statewide rank school, low to high.
CareerVote is a social rating, review and tagging mashup that allows people to find and share information about the work environment at different companies.

IndiaTweetz- Tweets and News about India- is a one stop Twitter based portal to tap the buzz in India.Tweets are categorized in groups like Headlines,Cricket,Politics,Business, Bollywood,Celebrities,Cities etc.
Browse the #1 hits from the past 60 years and read the news during that time!

Developers can use this this mashup to insert a Giphy search bot into their HipChat sessions. Whenever a user types /giphy plus a keyword, the Lucille HipChat Bot will return a Gif that matches the search criteria. Requirements for implementation include the Python HipChat Library.
Search the prices on 43,000 hotels worldwide. Filter hotels to suit your needs and then make reservations.
At GPSies.com, you can view and download tracks that have been recorded by a GPS device. Search for running, hiking, and biking routes. You can download all of the tracks.
Google map mashup with cards from the World of Warcraft card game. Browse around the screen, zoom in, and explore all the Heroes of Azeroth cards.

SnapsBoard help to preserve photos and videos in the original resolution. The mashup's principle: never lose a photo, is related to privacy, personalization, and categorization found in the app. While organizing digital images could be important for some members, others prefer to print images from a smart phone. That's why SnapsBoard offers a Walgreen's printing service connected to the phone.
Over 8,600 colleges and universities in the US plotted on a Google map with street views and additional school information.
SDB Explorer has been made as an industry leading graphical user interface (GUI) to explore Amazon SimpleDB service thoroughly and in a very efficient and user friendly way.

With the AYLIEN Text Analysis API, web users can analyze text from social media using Google Spreadsheet. The way this add-on works is by copying and pasting text from the social media channel to be analyzed. One of the main benefits of this tool is the evaluation of sentiment according to positive, negative, or neutral stream comments. Users can also summarize text, detect language, and classify documents. To use Text Analysis, users need to sign up to Google to access, run, and test the form.
mygoogleplus.com uses Google+ API to transform user profile into a Facebook style timeline.
The Whys between follows on the Web. Browser plugin to assist in finding out why people follow the people they do on Twitter.

BusinessWeek magazine will use the LinkedIn API to embed links within content that allows you to click on a company name and see who you are connected to via LinkedIn. Note: not yet live as of Dec 11th 2007.
View stores, beaches, apartments, and other French data on a Google map. Lets you select a place to live near places of interest. Click an item to view photographs of the places.
A fun method to learn and improve your foreign languages like English, French or Italian through music and typing-in song lyrics.
Use this Mashup to convert a document of any file format into a downloadable HTML file. This mashup uses the HP IDOL OnDemand View Document API.
Pictajam lets users instantly create a public, shareable profile from their Instagram photo stream. Send and share images with anyone in the world.
CoffeeSeeker lets you find and discover coffee shops near you. You can save your favorite coffee shops, rate them, or add new ones.
PrintCentral is a mobile printing app for the iPhone. Using its integration with Box.net, users are now able to access and print their Box files from within PrintCentral.
If the earth were a sandwich. Fun way to find the antipodal, oposite side, point for any place on the earth. See them both side-by-side and drag them around. From Ze Frank.
Find rideshare matches among craigslist rideshare ads, according to your estimated route. Uses craigslist, Google Maps, and postgres.
Passione non profit is an Italian site. It appears to be an aggregate of non profit blog posts.

The website historicplaces.net was created in 2012 as a comprehensive listing of buildings, structures, objects, and sites in North America that have received a special status based on their historical or archaeological significance. We have almost 100.000 historic places listed in our database.
TodoToday for Voo2do is a simple task manager application to show only the current due and overdue tasks from Voo2do.com.
Social Butterfly allows you to anonymously chat with random strangers through Google Talk. If you use Gmail, you already have Google Talk.

Locago is a mobile framework with an open API for third party content. GPS enable, turn-by-turn navigation, global map coverage and supported by 105+ different phone models. 45+ different content layers available in Locago.
Search and watch free Bangla music video songs, Bangla Natoks, Bangladesh models, actors, actresses, Bangladesh movies, Bengali drama serials, Bangladesh news, TV shows, sports and more.
100 Destinations aggregations photos and quotes from sites like Twitter and allows users to experience what I city is like from an insiders perspective.

Greener pastures ranks U.S. cities based on the greenness of their available housing stock. In a graph, each line represent a city's greenness over time. You can hover over a line to see which city it represents and compare.
Island Eye has been created to achieve a focal island portal specializing in the History and Tourism of the Isle of Wight. It also helps support Island businesses and voluntary sectors.
MP3 Search directory with information on each artist and genre.
Location, seedings, and dynamically updating brackets for all of the Division I college basketball conference tournaments.
